# SCI-MAP v0.2/r0.1 decision change log

Date: 2026-09-07. Status: candidate change record; no freeze or activation.

The immutable SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.7.1 ledger recorded OD-001--007 and OD-009 as
open and OD-008 as resolved. The 2026-08-28 owner record resolves the eight
open questions for an explicitly versioned successor. The admitted uniform
coefficient authority subsequently fills one exact PTC family slot. This file
records those state changes without editing or reinterpreting the predecessor.

| Decision | Frozen predecessor state | v0.2/r0.1 state | Normative successor change | Unchanged boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SCI-MAP-OD-001 | Open; formula labeled adopted policy | Decided | Names operational relative-support purpose and prohibits physical optimality/significance interpretation. | Formula, population, order statistic, and thresholds unchanged. |
| SCI-MAP-OD-002 | Open change authority | Decided | Preserves free experimentation; official identity follows equivalence/versioned change control and claim-appropriate evidence. | No permission process for research is created. |
| SCI-MAP-OD-003 | Open minimum response obligation | Decided | Requires known MAP-local realized-operator disclosure and separately honest upstream-conditioned/whole-chain states. | Three inherited response families and complete-signal-membership rules unchanged. |
| SCI-MAP-OD-004 | Open persistence form | Decided | Allows complete, partial, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, or unavailable covariance disclosure according to actual information. | No complete model is manufactured; base validity is not automatically lost. |
| SCI-MAP-OD-005 | Open abstract publication duty | Decided | Separates required logical bundle from plan-controlled physical persistence and admits equivalent in-memory/persisted/coadd-only routes. | Every plan-required publication completes or fails; PTC completion is not waived. |
| SCI-MAP-OD-006 | Open Pointing/OOF registration | Decided | Permits conforming operator reuse. | Mode science, profile, WCS/frame, fitting, outputs, defaults, and qualification remain outside MAP. |
| SCI-MAP-OD-007 | Open numerical domain | Decided | Adds finite-nonnegative domain, zero/ordinary/expert/failure behavior, four state/value stages, and no universal default. | Exact support formulas, inclusive comparisons, population, and order statistic unchanged. |
| SCI-MAP-OD-008 | Resolved | Decided, carried unchanged | No new change. | One-hot half-open projection remains the only ordinary family. |
| SCI-MAP-OD-009 | Open canonical-grid/future transform authority | Decided | Allows preconstruction target-grid request and exact centered-integer embedding; identifies later crop as a new product. | Fractional resampling, interpolation, reprojection, and mosaicking remain undefined. |
| PTC-OD-010 / admitted uniform family | Registry architecture resolved but frozen MAP slot unfilled | Decided architecture with one admitted family available by exact explicit handoff | References `SCI-PTC:uniform_constant@draft-0.1`, its owner-approved profile, MAP permission, and exact boundary. | No default/fallback, other family, realized handoff, activation, or producer-science duplication. |

No stable MAP requirement or prediction identifier was added, removed, or
renumbered. The exact clause-level mapping is in
`PREDECESSOR_SUCCESSOR_MAPPING.md`.
